-- Product Performance Analysis
-- Analyze product sales, quantity, customer reach, lifespan,
-- recency, pricing, and overall performance.

WITH ProductAggregation AS (
    SELECT
        P.product_name AS [Product Name],
        P.category AS [Category],
        P.subcategory AS [Subcategory],
        P.cost AS [Cost],

        -- Calculate total sales generated by each product
        SUM(F.sales_amount) AS [Total Sales],

        -- Calculate total quantity sold for each product
        SUM(F.quantity) AS [Total Quantity],

        -- Count the number of unique customers who purchased each product
        COUNT(DISTINCT F.customer_key) AS [Total Customers],

        -- Calculate the product's lifespan in months
        -- from the first order to the most recent order
        DATEDIFF(
            MONTH,
            MIN(F.order_date),
            MAX(F.order_date)
        ) AS [Product Lifespan (Months)],

        -- Calculate the number of months since the product was last ordered
        DATEDIFF(
            MONTH,
            MAX(F.order_date),
            GETDATE()
        ) AS [Months Since Last Order],

        -- Calculate the average selling price per unit
        SUM(F.sales_amount) /
            NULLIF(SUM(F.quantity), 0) AS [Average Selling Price],

        -- Calculate the average monthly revenue generated by the product
        SUM(F.sales_amount) /
            NULLIF(
                DATEDIFF(
                    MONTH,
                    MIN(F.order_date),
                    MAX(F.order_date)
                ),
                0
            ) AS [Average Monthly Revenue]

    FROM fact_sales AS F

    -- Join sales data with product information
    JOIN dim_products AS P
        ON F.product_key = P.product_key

    -- Aggregate sales information at the product level
    GROUP BY
        P.product_name,
        P.category,
        P.subcategory,
        P.cost
)

SELECT
    *,

    -- Classify products based on their total sales performance
    CASE
        WHEN [Total Sales] > 300000
            THEN 'High Performance'

        WHEN [Total Sales] > 150000
            THEN 'Medium Performance'

        ELSE 'Low Performance'
    END AS [Product Performance]

FROM ProductAggregation;
